description: the 4.2 server standing as a pNFS METADATA server: LAYOUTGET, LAYOUTCOMMIT, LAYOUTRETURN and GETDEVICEINFO are required rather than explored, so failing to advertise EXCHGID4_FLAG_USE_PNFS_MDS is a failure and not a skip. Its own corpus because the plain profiles above require the opposite of the same server; delegations stay off for the same back-channel reason.
